io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class EntityCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.EntityCompat

  • public final class EntityCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Compatibility helpers for entity-related API that changed across Minecraft versions.

    The predicate-filtered World#getNearbyEntities(Location, double, double, double, Predicate) overload was only added in 1.9. The unfiltered four-argument variant has existed since 1.8, so we fetch with that and apply the predicate in Java, which behaves identically on every version.

      • entityType

        public static org.bukkit.entity.EntityType entityType(java.lang.String name)
        Resolves an EntityType by name, returning null when the constant does not exist on the running server version (rather than throwing). Lets code reference entity types added in later versions without a hard compile or runtime dependency on the constant.
        Parameters:
        name - The EntityType constant name (e.g. "PIGLIN")
        Returns:
        The matching EntityType, or null if absent on this version

      • isGliding

        public static boolean isGliding(java.lang.Object entity)
        Reflective LivingEntity#isGliding() (1.9+). Returns false on older servers, which have no elytra gliding.
        Parameters:
        entity - The entity (a LivingEntity at runtime)
        Returns:
        Whether the entity is gliding

      • getFacing

        public static org.bukkit.block.BlockFace getFacing(java.lang.Object entity)
        Reflective Entity#getFacing() (1.13+). Falls back to BlockFace.NORTH on older servers where the method is absent.
        Parameters:
        entity - The entity (an Entity at runtime)
        Returns:
        The facing direction, or BlockFace.NORTH if unavailable
